# Reviewed third-party static content

This directory contains eight ROOT-adapted instruction skills and their reviewed
Markdown references. It is a vendored reference archive, not a runtime installation.
Do not register this directory wholesale with Hermes or another agent.

- [Manifest and governance](../curated/README.md)
- [Review decisions and adaptations](../curated/REVIEW.md)
- [Superpowers attribution](superpowers/NOTICE.md) and [MIT license](superpowers/LICENSE)
- [Research workflow attribution](agent-skills/NOTICE.md) and [MIT license](agent-skills/LICENSE)

File identities are pinned in the manifest. No scripts, hooks, package manifests,
plugins, symlinks or executable files are part of this curated pack. Local file
names do not authorize tool execution or installation of referenced dependencies.
